outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomics cluster map overlaid on a tissue image (micrograph-type visualization), not a bar/summary plot of averaged data.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; not a data plot showing averages.
Spatial expression heatmaps over tissue sections; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change statistic per gene from a differential expression comparison (Seurat FindMarkers), not a mean of multiple replicate measurements, so there are no individual data points to overlay.
